easyPrerequisites: Transdimensional Bovine and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Transdimensional Bovine by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Tidewater Minion and Transdimensional Bovine, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Tidewater Minion ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
